opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC); PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including research visits to collaborators and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities connecting communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' engagement skills, engaging school and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs of care that the applicant usually provides. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover costs of support/assistance required for a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports reducing accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering costs of specific support such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software/hardware for chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.
